subject: ISO/FedRAMP scope validation & evidence inventory
messages:
From: Keena Audit <security@keenaudit.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: BlueHarbor engagement — initial evidence inventory request

Hi Sofia / team,

Per our intake call last week, BlueHarbor asked us to validate Redwood's scope for ISO 27001 and FedRAMP readiness ahead of their Q2 procurement window. To get started we need a first-pass evidence inventory and a short note on where artifacts live (S3 path / Drive / ticketing).

Could you share: 1) a single-sheet inventory listing control IDs, control owner, evidence file name/path, earliest available date; 2) any known gaps (e.g., controls with no evidence or 3rd-party attestations pending); and 3) the proposed sample window you expect for the assessment (past 12 months vs rolling 6 months).

If you have a simple CSV/Excel stub, attach it and we'll review and produce a sample plan. We expect to start control validation the week of 2026-12-14.

Attachments requested: evidence inventory stub (CSV/Excel), recent SOC 2 report (if available), and any CAIQ/SIG you already completed.

Thanks,
Jordan Keene
Engagement Lead — KeenAudit
security@keenaudit.com

---
(attachment: intake_template.csv - CSV stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Keena Audit <security@keenaudit.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor engagement — initial evidence inventory request

Jordan —

Thanks, and good to confirm scope. We're happy to run a quick control-validation sprint and share an initial inventory. Quick notes:

- We will provide an "evidence_inventory_v0.4.xlsx" with the columns you requested (control_id, control_name, owner, file_path, earliest_date, notes).
- For ISO 27001 vs FedRAMP mapping, I attached a simplified control_map (control_map_iso_fedramp_v1.csv). This flags controls that map to both schemes.
- Sample window: we recommend 12 months for the FedRAMP-aligned sample and 6 months for ISO operational evidence where applicable, but we can adjust based on BlueHarbor preferences.

Action items on our side (owners):
- Marcus: populate technical control evidence links (S3/Drive) and note any encrypted artifacts.
- Mina: inventory of auditor-facing logs and retention policies; call out retention gaps.
- Priya: provide SOC 2 summary and any completed CAIQ sections.

I'll attach the initial inventory and a short kickoff agenda (MAP-kickoff-agenda.pdf). We can run a 45-minute sync to walk through the matrix next Wednesday (2026-12-02) or Thursday — what's best for your team?

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
(attachment: evidence_inventory_v0.4.xlsx)
(attachment: control_map_iso_fedramp_v1.csv)
(attachment: MAP-kickoff-agenda.pdf)

From: Keena Audit <security@keenaudit.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor engagement — initial evidence inventory request

Sofia / Marcus / Mina,

This is great — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions after a quick pass through the workbook:

1) In the control_map CSV some entries list "ticketing:/infra#1234" as the path. For validation we'll need either a direct Drive/S3 path or the ticket URL plus a short note on retention policy. Can Marcus confirm where those artifacts are stored?

2) For controls tied to 3rd-party services (monitoring, identity), please indicate if you have a current AOC/SOC for the provider or if we'll need to ask for attestations.

3) Sampling: BlueHarbor is leaning toward a rolling 12-month window but asked whether we can tighten to 9 months for controls where activity is sparse. That is acceptable from our side but please flag any control where evidence does not exist for the last 9 months.

We can do the kickoff 2026-12-02 at 10:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite to the email thread.

Regards,
Jordan Keene
Engagement Lead — KeenAudit
(attachment: sample-plan-template.docx)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Keena Audit <security@keenaudit.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor engagement — initial evidence inventory request

Jordan — thanks, confirmed for 12/02 10:00 PT. A couple of extra items we'll bring to the kickoff:

- A short runbook describing our artifact access model (S3 bucket prefixes, Drive folder ACLs, and ticketing links). I'll attach the internal runbook excerpt during the meeting.
- A list of controls with pending 3rd-party attestations (we have two vendors with expiring AOCs in Jan 2027; we'll flag those in the inventory notes).
- A proposal for the validation sprint: 2-week focused run, prioritized by control criticality and BlueHarbor risk appetite. If the sponsor prefers, we can split into two 1-week sprints (ISO-focused / FedRAMP-focused).

Next steps (short):
- Marcus to update the inventory with direct URLs or ticket links + retention notes by EOD 2026-12-01.
- Mina to surface log retention evidence and any sampling limitations.
- Priya to export SOC 2 checklist excerpt and completed CAIQ pages.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
